Sean —

Thanks for the detail. Quick questions:

- Banner grommet layout looks fine but we usually need a 2\" reinforced hem at the top for the lift spreader bar. Is that feasible to add to the final art?
- Do we have a dock reservation number from Moscone? The permit PDF is good, but Moscone needs the internal reservation ID to process the overnight escort.
- Do you want the rigging crew to pre-rig the lift pad before the truck arrives (we can bring scaffolding), or do you want us to hand off fully built and only land the banner? Pre-rigging adds ~45 minutes to crew time.

We can provide one vehicle escort for the 26' truck. If the scissor lift moves separately we can add a second escort (additional fee).

If you can send confirmation on the hem and the dock reservation ID I can lock crew and start the DocuSign for our service order.

Cheers — Frank

Frank Molloy
